event.name: KBW Drink Mixer: Presented by Circle x Auros x BDACS x Mento
event.descriptionText:
🍸 Drinks Social with Circle, Auros, BDACS, and Mento
Join us for a relaxed social gathering during Korean Blockchain Week, where you can connect with fellow industry professionals in a warm and inviting setting. Sip on expertly crafted cocktails and enjoy gourmet canapés at one of Seoul’s premier hotel bars known for its elegant atmosphere and friendly vibe. See you there! 
💡 RSVP Details:
This event is strictly invite-only. Attendance is by invitation only, and each invite is non-transferable. Due to limited availability, registrations will undergo a review process, and confirmations will be sent to those whose attendance has been approved.
We expect a full house, so please RSVP at your earliest convenience. If you can no longer attend, make sure to cancel your reservation. Your RSVP and/or attendance constitutes your consent to receive email communications and photography for the hosts' marketing purposes.
By attending this event, you agree to be photographed and/or filmed, granting permission for your likeness to be used in promotional and marketing materials, and by registering, you consent to the use of the information you provide to contact you about this event and other marketing communications.
​​About Auros
Auros is a leading global market-making and algorithmic trading firm founded by seasoned industry veterans with over 20 years of experience. Auros executes billions in daily notional turnover, leveraging advanced liquidity solutions to stabilize markets and foster growth across the digital asset ecosystem.
Beyond its trading expertise, Auros offers a suite of tailored services to support token projects throughout their lifecycle, including its distinctive Strategic Market Making service, DeFi and on-chain engineering solutions, bespoke OTC execution, and strategic investment support. These capabilities empower Auros' partners to confidently navigate the complexities from TGE to growth and beyond.
​​For more information, visit auros.global or follow Auros on X and LinkedIn.
​​About ​​Circle
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is a global financial technology firm that enables businesses of all sizes to harness the power of digital currencies and public blockchains for payments, commerce, and financial applications worldwide. Circle is building the world’s largest, most-widely used, stablecoin network, and issues, through its regulated affiliates, USDC and EURC stablecoins. Circle provides a comprehensive suite of financial and technology services that empower enterprises and developers to integrate stablecoins and blockchains into their products, services and business operations.
​​About BDACS 
BDACS is a fully regulated digital asset custodian in Korea, delivering secure, compliant, and tailored prime custody services for institutional clients. Our robust infrastructure and strategic partnerships with leading firms across technology and digital finance enable seamless portfolio construction and management. As the digital asset landscape evolves, BDACS empowers institutions to scale with confidence and clarity.
​​About Mento
Mento is the leading onchain FX and decentralized stablecoin platform, enabling the most efficient trading for multi-currency stablecoins at real-world FX rates through its novel fixed-price market maker (FPMM) pools. Built for both institutions and individuals, Mento powers real-world financial use cases such as cross-border payments, credit markets, currency hedging, and more through a growing portfolio of 15+ stablecoins. Mento can also support the integration of any currency stablecoin—native or third-party stablecoins—into its FX infrastructure.

event.descriptionText:
We are also excited to announce that we are partnering with Singapore Blockchain Week (SBW 2026), the world's first cross-border blockchain week, taking place November 13-17 across Singapore and the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone in Malaysia.　Singapore Blockchain Week（SBW 2026）とのパートナーシップも発表します。SBW 2026は、世界初のクロスボーダー型ブロックチェーンウィークで、11月13〜17日にシンガポールおよびジョホール・シンガポール特別経済区（マレーシア）にて開催されます。
SBW 2026 brings together policymakers, financial institutions, venture capital, exchanges, infrastructure providers, and enterprise leaders to shape the next generation of cross-border finance and Web3 infrastructure in Southeast Asia. SBW has already been active across the region this year, co-hosting events at the National University of Singapore during SuperAI Week (https://luma.com/9vdktnrz) and partnering with OffChain Global during the Hong Kong Web3 Festival (https://luma.com/n58km1q8?tk=jYvKaV).　SBW 2026には、政策立案者、金融機関、ベンチャーキャピタル、取引所、インフラプロバイダー、企業リーダーが一堂に会し、東南アジアにおける次世代のクロスボーダー金融とWeb3インフラの未来を形作ります。SBWは今年すでに各地で精力的に活動しており、SuperAI Week中にシンガポール国立大学でのイベントを共催し（https://luma.com/9vdktnrz）、香港Web3 FestivalではOffChain Globalとも提携しています（https://luma.com/n58km1q8?tk=jYvKaV）。
To celebrate our partnership, we will be raffling off 2 free tickets to the SBW 2026 conference. If you are interested in entering the raffle, please send an email to contactstealthfounders@gmail.com. You can learn more about Singapore Blockchain Week here: https://luma.com/cvl6h0s0.　このパートナーシップを記念して、SBW 2026のチケット2枚が当たる抽選会を実施します。抽選への参加をご希望の方は、contactstealthfounders@gmail.com までメールをお送りください。Singapore Blockchain Weekの詳細はこちら：https://luma.com/cvl6h0s0。
If you work in DeFi, stablecoins, tokenization, NFT infrastructure, crypto exchanges, blockchain development, or anything related to the intersection of Web3 and digital assets, this night is for you. This is an unofficial side event to warm up for WebX 2026 (July 13-14, Tokyo International Forum), Asia's largest Web3 conference.　DeFi、ステーブルコイン、トークン化、NFTインフラ、暗号資産取引所、ブロックチェーン開発など、Web3とデジタルアセットの融合に関わっている方なら、この夜はあなたのためのイベントです。本イベントは、アジア最大級のWeb3カンファレンス「WebX 2026」（7月13〜14日、東京国際フォーラム）に向けたウォームアップを兼ねた非公式サイドイベントです。
The crypto and Web3 space in Japan is accelerating. Stablecoin regulation is opening new doors, institutional players are entering tokenized assets, and Layer 1 and Layer 2 ecosystems are scaling faster than ever. We are bringing together the people who are building and shaping the next generation of digital finance.　日本における暗号資産・Web3の動きは加速しています。ステーブルコイン規制が新たな扉を開き、機関投資家がトークン化資産に参入し、Layer 1・Layer 2エコシステムはかつてないスピードで拡大しています。次世代のデジタル金融を構築し、形作っている人たちが集まります。
You'll get the chance to meet:
Blockchain and smart contract engineers
Crypto exchange and custody operators
DeFi protocol builders and tokenization specialists
Data analysts and researchers in on-chain analytics
Founders, product managers, and operators in the Web3 space

ブロックチェーン・スマートコントラクトエンジニア

No presentations. No slides. Just good people sharing stories and chatting openly about what it's really like to build in Web3 and crypto today. No gatekeeping, no formal talks: just real conversations. Think of it as a pre-WebX warmup with the people you actually want to meet.　プレゼンなし。スライドなし。Web3・クリプトの世界で実際にビルドする中でのリアルな話を、気の合う人たちと自由に語り合うだけ。ゲートキーピングも、堅いトークもありません。ただの本音トークです。WebXの前に、本当に会いたい人たちと繋がるウォームアップの場です。
If you're building, deploying, investing, or thinking about creating something in the Web3 and crypto space, you'll fit right in.　Web3・クリプト分野で、作っている人、デプロイしている人、投資している人、これから何かを始めたいと考えている人なら、きっと馴染めるはずです。

Beyond Price: The On-Chain and Social Metrics That Actually Drive Alpha in Digital Asset Markets
Suzanne Pace — Institutional Director, Santiment
가격이 움직이기 전후, 온체인 활동과 소셜 대화에서는 어떤 변화가 나타날까요? 데이터가 보여주는 것과 보여주지 못하는 것을 구분하고, 시장의 관심과 내러티브를 리서치의 맥락으로 읽는 방법을 살펴봅니다.
Explore what on-chain and social data can—and cannot—tell us, and how to use activity, attention, and narratives as context for market research.
💬 18:30–19:00 | Panel & open conversation
Beyond the Chart · 차트 너머의 신호와 사람들
사람들은 왜 새로운 Web3 제품을 사용하고, 무엇을 믿으며, 어떤 경험 때문에 다시 돌아올까요? 데이터·제품·커뮤니티를 연결해, 서로 다른 분야의 경험을 누구나 이해하기 쉬운 질문으로 나눕니다.
What makes people try a Web3 product, trust it, and keep coming back? Our panel brings together perspectives on data, products, and communities through questions everyone can join in on.

🛠️ 19:25–19:50 | Aomi Labs workshop
From Intent to Execution: how an execution harness turns AI into onchain action
Cecilia Zhang — Founder, Aomi Labs
“내 ETH를 리밸런싱해줘”라는 요청이 실제 트랜잭션으로 완료되기까지 어떤 과정이 필요할까요? Aomi의 실행 하네스가 AI 에이전트의 체인 상태 조회, 포크 환경 시뮬레이션, 사용자 소유 지갑의 안전한 트랜잭션 실행을 어떻게 지원하는지 살펴봅니다.
What actually happens between "rebalance my ETH" and a settled transaction, and how Aomi's execution harness lets any AI agent read chain state, simulate on a fork, and commit transactions safely to the user's own wallet.
